entries.text: Export to Excel on work item lists (project, workspace views, Your work, module and department views). The file has the rows you see, with the same filters and order.
A new position, Assistant manager, between Supervisor and Manager. A Super Admin assigns it in God Mode.
You can edit and delete your own announcements on the Announcements page.
Chat messages and announcements show Markdown: bold, italic, lists, links, quotes, tables and code.
Files dropped or pasted into a description or comment appear as cards with an icon, size, preview and download. Older attachment links on their own line look the same.
Announcement emails show formatting instead of symbols, and their button opens the Announcements page.
Mention cards inside a work item panel stay open when you click them, and work item mentions open the work item.
A mention added to a description now notifies the person even when it is saved a moment later.
